Hellstorm
40 Rage
Instant cast30 sec cooldown
Create a hellstorm, dealing 75+3.2 Points Per Level+FireP*0.320357+AP*0.08 Fire damage to up to 8 nearby enemies.

Embers then flare every 1 sec for 2 sec, dealing 3+2.4 Points Per Level+FireP*0.025+AP*0.025 Fire damage.

Duration is increased by 100% for each stack of Demonfire consumed.
